services.name: AI Voice Calling
services.short: AI voice agents that answer and place calls in Hindi and English, and hand over to your team when needed.
services.title: AI Voice Calling Agents in Hindi & English
services.description: AI voice agents for inbound and outbound calls in Hindi and English. Barge-in, live transfer to agents, CRM sync. On-premise or managed.
services.intro: Our AI voice agents hold natural phone conversations in Hindi, English and Hinglish. They qualify leads, confirm orders, collect payments reminders and answer common questions, then pass the call to a human agent with the full context when the caller needs one.
features: Callers can interrupt mid-sentence (barge-in) and the agent responds immediately, like a person would.
One agent switches language with the caller instead of forcing an IVR menu choice.
Hands the call to a human agent with a summary of what was already said.
Works over your existing SIP trunks, PRI or GSM gateways through FreeSWITCH.
Every call outcome, transcript and tag is pushed to your CRM or any webhook.
Recordings, transcripts, intent and sentiment per call, searchable later.
use_cases: Lead qualification for real estate, education and insurance
faqs: Which languages does the AI agent speak?
Hindi, English and mixed Hinglish out of the box. Other Indian languages can be added per project.
Can it work with our existing phone lines?
Yes. It connects to SIP trunks, PRI lines or GSM gateways, so you keep your numbers.
Can we host it on our own server?
Yes. You can run it on your premises with your data staying in your network, or use our managed service.

services.name: IVR Solutions
services.short: Multi-level IVR with keypad and speech input, time-based routing and prompts in any language.
services.title: IVR System for Business — Multi-level, Speech & DTMF
services.description: Multi-level IVR with DTMF and speech input, time-based routing, multi-language prompts and CRM lookups. Hosted or on-premise.
services.intro: Route every caller to the right person on the first try. We design the call flow with you, record or generate the prompts, and connect the IVR to your agents, queues and business systems.
features: Menus, sub-menus, queues and fallbacks designed around how your customers actually call.
Callers press keys or simply say what they need.
Different flows for office hours, after hours and holidays.
Hindi, English and regional prompts, recorded or text-to-speech.
Read order status, balances or ticket updates from your database during the call.
Hold queues with position announcements and automatic callbacks.
faqs: Can we change the IVR menu ourselves?
Yes. Prompts and routing can be updated from the panel without calling us.
Do you provide toll-free or virtual numbers?
Yes, through our telecom partners, or we connect the IVR to numbers you already own.
Can the IVR fetch data from our software?
Yes, through an API or a direct database lookup during the call.

services.name: Voice Broadcast
services.short: Send recorded or AI-generated voice messages to thousands of numbers, with keypad responses and live reports.
services.title: Voice Broadcast & Bulk Voice Calls (OBD) Platform
services.description: High-CPS voice broadcast platform with trunk failover, DID rotation, DTMF capture and live reports. White-label for resellers.
services.intro: Reach large lists in minutes with recorded or text-to-speech voice messages. Callers can press a key to talk to an agent, confirm, or opt out, and every response is reported live.
features: Dial thousands of calls per minute with pacing per trunk.
Calls move to a backup trunk automatically, and caller IDs rotate to improve answer rates.
Capture DTMF input such as 1 to confirm, 2 to talk to an agent, 9 to opt out.
Schedule campaigns by time window and retry unanswered numbers.
Brand the panel as your own and bill your clients monthly.
Answered, busy, failed and DTMF results per campaign, exportable.
faqs: Can I resell the voice broadcast panel?
Yes. You get your own branding, an install key and a go-live key bound to your server, and you bill your clients directly.
Is it compliant with TRAI rules?
We set up DND scrubbing and calling-window limits; content approval stays with the sender.
How many calls can it handle?
It depends on your trunk capacity; the platform paces calls per trunk and scales with hardware.

services.name: Cloud Calling
services.short: A complete call center in the browser: virtual numbers, queues, call recording and live dashboards.
services.title: Cloud Calling & Cloud Call Center Software
services.description: Cloud call center with virtual numbers, ACD queues, auto and predictive dialing, call recording and live dashboards.
services.intro: Run inbound and outbound calling without PBX hardware. Agents log in from a browser or softphone from anywhere, and supervisors see every queue and call live.
features: Local, mobile and toll-free numbers mapped to teams and flows.
Progressive, preview and predictive modes for outbound teams.
Skill-based routing so calls reach the right agent.
Every call recorded and searchable, with retention you control.
Listen, whisper and barge into live calls.
Agent status, queue waits and call outcomes in real time.
faqs: Do agents need special hardware?
No. A browser with a headset is enough. IP phones are supported if you prefer them.
Can we move from our current PBX?
Yes. We can port or forward your numbers and run both side by side during the switch.
Is the dialer available on-premise?
Yes. The same dialer can run on your servers inside your office.

services.name: WebRTC Calling
services.short: Click-to-call from your website or app straight to your team, with no app to install.
services.title: WebRTC Calling — Click-to-Call & Browser Softphone
services.description: WebRTC click-to-call widgets and browser softphones over secure WSS, connected to your IVR, queues and agents.
services.intro: Let customers call you from a button on your website or app, and let your agents take calls from the browser. Calls run over encrypted WebRTC and land in the same queues as phone calls.
features: A call button for your website that connects to your IVR or a queue.
Agents make and receive calls in the browser with no install.
WSS signalling and encrypted media with valid TLS certificates.
Web calls use the same IVR, queues and recordings.
Embed calling inside your Android, iOS or web app.
Add video for KYC, consultations or support when needed.
use_cases: In-app calling between customers and agents
Field teams calling from mobile browsers
faqs: Does the caller need to install anything?
No. It works in Chrome, Edge, Firefox and Safari.
Are web calls recorded?
Yes, the same way phone calls are, if recording is enabled.
Can WebRTC calls reach normal phone numbers?
Yes. Calls can be bridged to SIP trunks and mobile numbers.

services.name: Business Voice & PBX
services.short: IP-PBX, SIP trunks, PRI and GSM gateways and IP phones, set up and supported end to end.
services.title: Business IP-PBX, SIP Trunks, PRI & GSM Gateway Setup
services.description: IP-PBX setup with SIP trunks, PRI and GSM gateways, IP phones and extensions, installed in your office and supported 24/7.
services.intro: We set up the telephony your office runs on: an IP-PBX with extensions, SIP trunks or PRI lines, GSM gateways and IP phones. We supply the hardware, configure it and support it.
features: Extensions, ring groups, voicemail, call transfer and conference.
Connect to your operator over SIP or PRI with failover between lines.
Use SIM-based lines for outbound calling where needed.
Desk phones and headsets supplied and provisioned.
Connect several offices on one numbering plan.
Every call logged to a database for billing and reports.
faqs: Do you supply the hardware?
Yes. Servers, gateways, IP phones and headsets can be supplied with the setup.
Can you work with our current operator?
Yes. We integrate with your existing SIP or PRI provider.
Is support included?
Yes. Setup includes support, and annual maintenance is available.

services.name: WhatsApp Business API
services.short: Official WhatsApp API with templates, chatbot flows, broadcasts and a shared team inbox.
services.title: WhatsApp Business API, Chatbot & Broadcast
services.description: Official WhatsApp Business API with approved templates, chatbot flows, broadcasts, shared team inbox and CRM integration.
services.intro: Talk to customers on WhatsApp at scale. We help you get onto the official API, build chatbot flows and templates, and give your team one inbox for every conversation.
features: Business verification, number setup and green-tick application support.
Approved templates for alerts, reminders and offers.
Menus, forms and FAQ bots that hand over to agents.
Send to opted-in lists with delivery and read reports.
Several agents on one number, with assignment and notes.
Connect to CRM, order systems and payment links.
faqs: Is this the official WhatsApp API?
Yes. We work only with the official WhatsApp Business Platform.
Can we use our existing number?
Yes, if it is not active on the WhatsApp app, or after it is moved off the app.
Can WhatsApp connect to the voice platform?
Yes. Missed calls, IVR choices and AI calls can trigger WhatsApp messages.

services.name: Bulk SMS
services.short: DLT-compliant transactional, promotional and OTP SMS with an API and delivery reports.
services.title: Bulk SMS Service — DLT Compliant OTP, Transactional & Promotional
services.description: DLT-compliant bulk SMS for OTP, transactional and promotional messages, with API, sender IDs and delivery reports.
services.intro: Send OTPs, alerts and campaigns over direct operator routes. We help with DLT registration, sender IDs and templates so messages get delivered.
features: Entity, header and template registration help.
Simple API for apps and websites.
Status per message, in the panel and via webhook.
faqs: Do you help with DLT registration?
Yes. We guide you through entity, header and template registration.
Is there an API?
Yes. An HTTP API with delivery report webhooks.
Can SMS be sent in Hindi?
Yes, Unicode SMS is supported.

services.name: RCS Messaging
services.short: Rich messages with images, cards, carousels and buttons from a verified business sender.
services.title: RCS Business Messaging — Rich Cards, Carousels & Verified Sender
services.description: RCS business messaging with verified sender, rich cards, carousels and action buttons, with SMS fallback.
services.intro: RCS turns a plain text message into an app-like experience inside the default messages app: your logo and name, images, carousels and buttons, with SMS fallback for phones that don't support it.
features: Your brand name and logo instead of a sender code.
Call, open a link, view a location or reply in one tap.
Unsupported phones receive a normal SMS.
Delivered, read and click data per message.
Customers can reply and pick suggested answers.
faqs: Which phones support RCS?
Most Android phones with the default messages app; others get an SMS fallback.
Do we need a separate approval?
Yes. Brand verification is required, and we handle the process with you.
Can RCS replace SMS?
It works alongside SMS: rich where supported, SMS everywhere else.

services.name: Missed Call Service
services.short: A number customers give a missed call to, with instant SMS or WhatsApp replies and lead capture.
services.title: Missed Call Service for Lead Generation & Opt-ins
services.description: Missed call numbers for lead capture, opt-ins, polls and verification, with instant SMS or WhatsApp replies and CRM sync.
services.intro: The easiest call to action in India: give a missed call. The call disconnects automatically at no cost to the caller, and they instantly get a reply on SMS or WhatsApp while the lead lands in your CRM.
features: Separate numbers per campaign to measure each one.
Automatic SMS or WhatsApp reply to every missed call.
Caller number, time and campaign saved to your CRM.
Have an agent or the AI agent call the person back.
One number per option for votes and subscriptions.
Calls per campaign, per hour and per region.
faqs: Is the call free for the customer?
Yes. The call disconnects automatically, so the caller is not charged.
Can the AI agent call them back?
Yes. A missed call can trigger an AI or agent callback.
How fast is the reply?
SMS and WhatsApp replies go out within seconds.

services.name: CRM
services.short: Leads, pipelines and follow-ups with your calls, WhatsApp and SMS logged against every customer.
services.title: CRM with Built-in Calling, WhatsApp & SMS
services.description: CRM for sales and support teams with lead pipelines, follow-ups, and calls, WhatsApp and SMS logged per customer.
services.intro: A CRM built around communication. Every call, recording, WhatsApp chat and SMS is attached to the customer record, so your team knows what happened before they pick up the phone.
features: Leads from your website, ads, missed calls and WhatsApp in one list.
Stages you define, with drag-and-drop deals.
Call from the record; the call and recording log automatically.
Tasks and reminders so no lead goes cold.
Managers see the team; agents see their own leads.
Conversion by source, agent and stage.
faqs: Does the CRM work with your dialer?
Yes. Calls from the dialer and AI agent log into the CRM automatically.
Can we import our existing leads?
Yes, from Excel or CSV.
Can it be customised?
Yes. Fields, stages and reports can be set up for your process.

services.name: HRMS
services.short: Attendance, leave, payroll inputs and employee self-service for growing teams.
services.title: HRMS Software — Attendance, Leave, Payroll & Self-Service
services.description: HRMS for attendance, shifts, leave, payroll inputs, onboarding and employee self-service. Hosted or on your server.
services.intro: Manage your people without spreadsheets. Attendance, shifts, leave and payroll inputs in one system, with a self-service portal for employees.
features: Biometric, mobile or web check-in with shift rosters.
Attendance-linked salary inputs, exportable to your payroll or Tally.
Offer letters, documents and checklists for new joiners.
Payslips, leave requests and profile updates.
Optionally link agent login hours from the dialer.
faqs: Can it connect to biometric devices?
Yes, common biometric attendance devices can be integrated.
Does it export to Tally?
Yes. Payroll inputs can be exported for Tally or your payroll provider.
Can it run on our server?
Yes, on-premise or as a managed service.

services.name: LMS (Learning Management)
services.short: Train and onboard your team online: courses, video lessons, quizzes, certificates and progress reports.
services.title: LMS — Learning Management System for Employee Training
services.description: Learning management system for employee onboarding and training: courses, video lessons, quizzes, certificates and progress tracking. On-premise or managed.
services.intro: Put all your training in one place. Build courses from your own videos and documents, assign them to teams, test understanding with quizzes and see who has completed what. Ideal for onboarding new agents and keeping every team up to date.
features: Video, PDF and slide lessons organised into courses and learning paths.
Check understanding with quizzes, pass marks and retakes.
Automatic certificates when a learner completes a course.
Give each department or new joiner the right training plan.
See completion, scores and pending training for every learner.
Learners can study on their phone, laptop or office desktop.
use_cases: New agent onboarding in contact centres
faqs: Can we upload our own training videos?
Yes. Upload your videos, documents and slides and arrange them into courses.
Can it work with our HR system?
Yes. It can be connected with our HRMS so new joiners get their training plan automatically.
Can it run on our own server?
Yes. Like all our software, the LMS is available on-premise or as a managed service.

services.name: Ticket Solution (Helpdesk)
services.short: Helpdesk ticketing for customer and IT support: tickets from calls, email, WhatsApp and web, with SLAs and reports.
services.title: Ticket Solution — Helpdesk & Support Ticketing System
services.description: Helpdesk ticketing system for customer support and IT service desks. Tickets from calls, email, WhatsApp and web forms, SLA timers, escalation and reports. On-premise or managed.
services.intro: Never lose a complaint or request again. Every call, email, WhatsApp message or web request becomes a ticket with an owner, a deadline and a clear status, so customers get answers on time and managers see exactly where work is stuck.
features: Create tickets from calls, IVR, email, WhatsApp and your website.
Auto-assign by team or skill and escalate when a ticket is not handled in time.
Response and resolution targets with alerts before they are breached.
Customers get status updates by SMS, email or WhatsApp.
Saved answers and guides so agents resolve common issues faster.
Volumes, response times, SLA performance and agent workload.
faqs: Can tickets be created from phone calls?
Yes. It connects with our IVR and calling platform, so a call can open or update a ticket automatically.
Can customers check their ticket status?
Yes. They receive updates and can check the status using their ticket number.
Is it available on-premise?
Yes. You can run it on your own server or use it as a managed service from us.

services.name: Agile Dialer
services.short: Agile Cloud Dialer and Agile Dialer Software: predictive, progressive and preview dialing for busy contact centres.
services.title: Agile Dialer — Cloud Dialer & Dialer Software for Call Centres
services.description: Agile Cloud Dialer and on-premise Agile Dialer Software for contact centres: predictive, progressive and preview dialing, agent panels, recordings and live reports.
services.intro: Keep your agents talking, not dialing. Agile Dialer places calls automatically, connects answered calls to free agents and gives supervisors live control of every campaign. Use it from our cloud or install it on your own servers.
features: Choose the dialing mode that fits each campaign and team.
Customer details, scripts, dispositions and callbacks on one screen.
Upload lists, remove duplicates and DND numbers, recycle unanswered leads.
Every call recorded and searchable for quality checks.
Listen, whisper and barge in; live wallboards for supervisors.
Works with SIP trunks, PRI lines and GSM gateways.
faqs: What is the difference between Cloud Dialer and Dialer Software?
Agile Cloud Dialer runs on our servers, ready in a day. Agile Dialer Software is installed on your own servers and network.
Can it work with our GSM gateways?
Yes. It works with SIP trunks, PRI lines and GSM gateways, and we can supply the gateways too.
How many agents can it handle?
From a small team to large multi-site contact centres; we size the setup to your call volume.

services.name: Website Design
services.short: Corporate, e-commerce and landing-page websites that are fast, mobile-friendly and built to bring enquiries.
services.title: Website Design — Corporate, E-commerce & Landing Pages
services.description: Website design and development: corporate websites, e-commerce stores, responsive custom designs and landing pages built for enquiries.
services.intro: Your website is often the first conversation with a customer. We design and build sites that look sharp on every screen, load fast and make it easy for visitors to call, chat or send an enquiry.
features: Clear, professional sites that explain what you do and build trust.
Online stores with catalogue, cart, payments and order management.
Looks and works perfectly on phones, tablets and desktops.
A design made around your brand, not a generic template.
Focused pages for ads and campaigns that turn clicks into leads.
Chat, WhatsApp, call buttons and enquiry forms linked to your team.
faqs: Will the website work on mobile?
Yes. Every site we build is responsive and tested on phones, tablets and desktops.
Can you add chat or an AI assistant?
Yes. We can add chat, WhatsApp and an AI voice or chat assistant to your site.
Do you handle hosting and domain?
Yes. We can set up and manage the domain, hosting and SSL for you.

services.name: Digital Marketing
services.short: SEO, Google Ads (PPC), social media management, YouTube promotion and Instagram & Facebook ads.
services.title: Digital Marketing — SEO, Google Ads, Social Media & YouTube
services.description: Digital marketing services: search engine optimisation (SEO), Google Ads PPC, social media management, YouTube promotion and Instagram and Facebook sponsored ads.
services.intro: Reach the people already looking for what you sell. We plan and run your search, social and video marketing, and connect the leads straight to your sales team, calls and WhatsApp.
features: Rank higher on Google for the searches your customers make.
Pay-per-click campaigns that bring ready-to-buy visitors.
Regular posts, replies and growth on your social channels.
Get your videos in front of the right audience.
Sponsored campaigns targeted by location, interest and age.
Ad leads flow into calls, WhatsApp and your CRM instantly.
faqs: How soon will we see results?
Paid ads can bring enquiries within days; SEO builds steadily over a few months.
Do you report on results?
Yes. You get regular reports on reach, clicks, leads and cost per lead.
Can leads go directly to our sales team?
Yes. We connect ad leads to calls, WhatsApp and your CRM so nobody waits.
